integrity: Exact integer determinant grid, polynomial interpolation justified by independent parity and degree argument, strict analytic monotonicity; independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for unbiased zero-field Ising weights supported on a spanning tree of four labelled binary variables; not for arbitrary sixteen weights, cyclic interaction networks or nonzero external fields. Potential older unindexed equivalents remain a priority risk.
title: Tree-topology invariance and sharp correlation rigidity for the four-cube Hypercube ratio
